title: How Hormozi would scale a $309K personal styling business toward $1M+ with funnel, affiliate and ad fixes
summary: Hormozi audits a luxury personal styling business with strong retention and LTV:CAC but a leaky funnel and low lead volume. He prescribes a prioritized plan: fix conversion with a lead magnet and BANT qualification, add attribution and raise ad spend, then 10x a proven affiliate channel through manual outreach.

principles.text: Know what percentage of customers come from each source, then double down on the channel that delivers the most for the least effort.
principles.quote: I like to understand what percentage of customers are coming from every source so that I can see like is sometimes there's one where it's like oh 90% of my customers come from this

principles.text: A great lead magnet is pre-digested: do more front-end work so the prospect does less and gets value immediately.
principles.quote: we want to have an exceptional lead magnet which typically means we have to work more on the front end so that our Prospect has to work less and so it's kind of like pre- digesting the food

principles.text: Between a more valuable but slow lead magnet and a less valuable but immediate one, customers prefer the immediate one.
principles.quote: if you have the choice between two lead magnets one thing that's more valuable but takes longer and the other is less valuable but immediate this is the one that customers will rather have

principles.text: Give away your valuable lead magnet only to qualified leads, and qualify with BANT: budget, authority, need, timing.
principles.quote: when you give a very valuable lead magnet away you don't have to give it away to everyone and so we want to make our lead magnet super valuable but only give them to qualified customers

principles.text: Add good friction that repels bad leads while keeping good ones; avoid bad friction that drives everyone away.
principles.quote: good friction is something that increases the overall quality of the lead and gets out people who uh suck bad friction gets everyone out

principles.text: If you have a machine that turns $1 into $16 in 30 days, put in as much as you can; don't cap ad spend out of fear.
principles.quote: if you have a machine in front of you where you put a dollar in and and it spits out $16 back in 30 days why would you have any kind of limit on that budget
